final: WITH patient_ratios AS (SELECT ID, AVG(1.0 * HGB / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) AS ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall_avg FROM patient_ratios), above_overall AS (SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, o.overall_avg FROM patient_ratios p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.ratio > o.overall_avg), group_stats AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS group_avg FROM above_overall), final_patients AS (SELECT a.ratio, a.ratio - a.overall_avg AS above_overall, a.ratio - g.group_avg AS above_group FROM above_overall a CROSS JOIN group_stats g WHERE a.ratio > g.group_avg) SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(above_overall) AS avg_amount_above_overall, AVG(above_group) AS avg_amount_above_group FROM final_patients
